Artifact screen for one module (label mode)

Source: R/agent_labels.R
dot-label_artifact_screen.Rd

The deterministic inputs to the label-mode artifact gate, rendered as a text block appended to each module's label_evidence file: module size; how many of the dissociation-stress (immediate-early / heat-shock) genes sit among the top 25 hubs and in the whole module; when depth_cols are available, the module score's Spearman correlation with sequencing depth; and, when sample_col names a metadata column (e.g. patient), how much of the module's top-decile activity comes from a single sample. Each line states its threshold and whether the module meets it. Not an evidence fragment: it informs the gate but is never cited in supporting_claims.

Usage

.label_artifact_screen(ms, module_id, sample_col = NULL, depth_cols = NULL)

Arguments

ms

A ModuleSet.

module_id

The module to screen.

sample_col

Optional metadata column (e.g. 'Patient') for the single-sample share. Default NULL skips that line.

depth_cols

Optional metadata columns holding per-cell sequencing depth (e.g. c('nCount_RNA', 'nFeature_RNA')). Default NULL skips that line.

Value

A single character string.
